results.name: Air conditioner in the style of cyberpunk.
results.description: This air conditioner looks like a propeller from a mechanical machine with sharp metal blades, reminiscent of technical chaos and chaos. The air conditioner body shows signs of time: scuffs, scratches, control buttons covered with dust and dirt. It also displays menacing signs and symbols that seem to belong to some techno-religious sect, adding mystery and intrigue to the overall appearance. The color scheme of the model includes ominous shades such as black, gray, dirty pavement or rusty red, which enhances the post-apocalyptic mood and creates the feeling that this device exists in a world after a global catastrophe.
